description: The built-in workflows check flags third-party Actions not pinned to a full commit SHA, with no scanner installed, and ignores pinned, local, commented-out and run-text lines.

setup_files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/local
      # - uses: actions/cache@v3
      - run: echo "uses: actions/cache@v3"

prompt: Check the workflows for unpinned actions.

contains: actions/setup-node@v4 is not pinned to a full commit SHA
